# M16-S2 (SPEC Sec 12.2): string results are invalid for wasm exports.
# A //go:wasmexport function returning a string fails the build with
# unsupported result type, so no errCode convention can cover it. The
# //logos: spelling lowers to this form (rows for both spellings are
# DONE), so the Go form pins the shared check.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=js
env GOARCH=wasm

# A string result cannot serve as the int32 errCode: the build fails.
! go build -o app.wasm .
stderr 'unsupported result type string'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/wasmstrexport

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

//go:wasmexport bad
func bad() string { return "nope" }

func main() {}
